states.current: run=0; idle/wake initially unsignalled; thread blocks on first wake before any idle signal.
states.not_proof: B33BF0 waits indefinitely if nothing wakes this worker. A read of run=0 or application ready proves no epoch.
states.required: Admission initialized before CreateThread/ResumeThread; exact owner/thread identity; cooperative initial parked acknowledgement or a reviewed exclusive-start construction proof that also bars every future run/wake path. Waking with run=0 is only usable after exclusive admission, event validity and current-generation acknowledgement are established.

states.current: Only loop-head run check is present. A request can race after this check.
states.not_proof: Clearing run does not retract an already admitted iteration.
states.required: Atomically close with the same mechanism used for iteration entry; count/identify every admitted whole callback/frame iteration and acknowledge after the final one completes.

states.current: Callback is arbitrary native owner callback; its completion precedes the busy loop and both frame calls.
states.not_proof: run clear during callback still allows following begin/end; closure from this callback can wait for itself.
states.required: Retain callback context and all provider dependencies; define cooperative completion/failure and reentrant refusal/defer behavior; no self-wait or forced callback cancellation.

states.current: Loop sleeps while lifecycle depth is positive, then samples again; it does not check run/shutdown in that wait.
states.not_proof: A closer holding that lifecycle lock can prevent idle acknowledgement. Zero depth is only a sample.
states.required: Close admission before destructive/lifecycle lock acquisition and do not wait while holding a lock needed by admitted work; otherwise a reviewed cooperative close check is necessary.

states.current: Worker dispatches raw providers, using actual renderer and worker_end copied from the real frame graph.
states.not_proof: Application phase/ready and a pending idle event do not cover these callbacks.
states.required: A single domain identity and accounted iteration span clock/provider/callback/begin/end use; close cannot report success until provider calls have returned and no new entry can start.

states.current: One auto-reset idle event may still be signalled or may have been consumed by another waiter; worker waits wake.
states.not_proof: Signal has no requester/generation identity. A stale signal can satisfy a later stop, while repeated waits can block. Resetting the event alone races with signalling.
states.required: Exclusive close ownership and an acknowledgement for the current closed epoch with zero in-flight work. If closure is permanently one-shot, still prove this unique request and initial publication; no restart without reviewed contract.

states.current: Constructor and wrapper paths do not uniformly check Win32 results; missing reached providers throw; thread body has no closing/acknowledgement catch.
states.not_proof: NULL/invalid handles, WAIT_FAILED, missed signal, thrown callback or dead thread are not parked success. B28A90 ignores wait result.
states.required: Failure leaves admission closed/unknown and retained dependencies alive; exact creation/result/exception policy needed before exposing Owners. Do not synthesize acknowledgement or cleanup.

states.current: Destructor sets shutdown, signals wake, waits termination, deletes events; run loop ignores shutdown until run clears. Observed duplicate is checked only after raw drain.
states.not_proof: Destructive shutdown/join is not a live retained-owner close handshake; provider teardown after mutable escape remains barred.
states.required: Retain graph/context/events/worker storage and observation handles through all joins and failed work. Established escape obligation refuses drain before any destructive mutation; process-bound context cannot be silently replaced.
